name: Sala Ryoujoku no Cello Concours
original_name: セーラ 陵辱のチェロコンクール
source:
Main character is impressed with Sala wonderful musical performance. He suggests she should participate in a musical contest held in town. Sala is going to practice for competition for a month, and protagonist is going to help her with any means necessary.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
萨拉精彩的音乐表演给主角留下了深刻的印象。他建议她参加镇上举行的音乐比赛。萨拉要为比赛进行一个月的练习，主角会用一切必要的手段帮助她。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
